serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Amazing! These are the best baked beans on toast I ever had! 
Although it is my first time eating baked beans on toast so the bar wasn’t set high I guess…
Bot: I’m glad you liked it! 
#bot.Expression.clear
Bot: I have a few more ideas for a meal, but I must say that I’m quite troubled by the lack of assortment in the local shop.
Bot: There are so many recipes online, but I can’t find a way to acquire most of the ingredients. Do you know how to solve that problem?
You: I heard that there’s some shop for rich people that has all sorts of stuff, even real vegetables, but at the moment I’m not rich enough to afford going there.
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: No biggie, I’m sure we will manage somehow.
Bot: Even with limited resources, I have some ideas for what to prepare.
You: I’m looking forward to trying them out.
Bot: Just remember to buy some food from the shop so I have something to work with!
You: No problem.
